claims.author: andrewtoth
claims.harm: download manager remains stuck indefinitely in COMPLETE state if snapshot activation fails
claims.quote: If ActivateSnapshot fails, download manager is forever in COMPLETE state.

claims.author: evoskuil
claims.harm: introduces trust vectors and multi-gigabyte unvalidated blobs into the trustless P2P protocol
claims.quote: One is free to add trust vectors to his own node implementation. Shoving that into the p2p network is not acceptable.
claims.status_note: reply on record; standing not assessed yet

claims.author: eynhaender
claims.harm: violates trustless verification by introducing a protocol-level dependency on hardcoded chainparams Merkle roots
claims.quote: This PR violates "don't trust, verify" by introducing a new protocol-level dependency on trusted, hardcoded data (Merkle roots in chainparams) for accepting a UTXO set snapshot from untrusted P2P peers.
claims.status_note: reply on record; standing not assessed yet

claims.author: l0rinc
claims.harm: dual chainstate complicates validation code paths including reorgs, rescanning, and pruning for a temporary security downgrade
claims.quote: dual chainstate complicates every code path that touches validation - reorgs, wallet rescanning, pruning, the `*DANGER` suffixed methods... Adding P2P distribution on top makes this even more complex without addressing the fundamental issues.
claims.status_note: reply on record; standing not assessed yet

claims.author: stickies-v
claims.harm: adds further AssumeUTXO and dual-chainstate complexity to critical validation code
claims.quote: It adds a ton of validation complexity, and the benefits to me seem limited... Concept NACK any changes that add more AssumeUTXO complexity.
claims.status_note: reply on record; standing not assessed yet

claims.author: narula
claims.harm: imposes validation complexity on the codebase for a low-priority feature
claims.quote: Concept NACK, for the same reasons @l0rinc has articulated very well

claims.author: nkaretnikov
claims.harm: incurs implementation complexity, bugs, data usage, and trust assumptions despite unproven demand
claims.quote: this proposal comes with a bunch of concrete downsides: trust assumptions, implementation complexity leading to longer reviews and potential bugs, data usage.

claims.author: josibake
claims.harm: builds P2P distribution on an unsound AssumeUTXO foundation rather than optimizing full validation and bandwidth
claims.quote: AssumeUTXO is a bad proposal and adding the P2P mechanism on top of it is building on an unsound foundation.
